subject: EU Data Localization Playbook — stakeholders, owners, and 8-week MAP
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@heliofin.com>, HelioFin Security <security@heliofin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 14:12:00 +0200
Subject: EU Data Localization Playbook — stakeholders, owners, and 8-week MAP

Hi Olivia — great to connect yesterday. As discussed, we're proposing a collaborative playbook and a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to run a focused 8-week evaluation and cross-border review for HelioFin's EU workloads. The goal: validate data residency requirements, confirm permitted data flows, and land a production readiness checklist for a dedicated or private deployment.

High-level proposal (attached draft):
- Week 0 (this week): stakeholder roster + kickoff alignment
- Weeks 1–3: technical evaluation (data flows, network controls, model variant selection)
- Weeks 4–5: security evidence collection (SOC2 artifacts, audit logs, KMS details)
- Weeks 6–7: trial runs and perf/latency benchmarks inside EU region(s)
- Week 8: close review, go/no-go decision and next steps (contracting/committed capacity)

Immediate asks for kickoff:
1) Please confirm the primary owners for: Data Governance, Security Architecture, Legal/Privacy, and Product Ops.
2) Can you share the current list of EU-managed regions and whether any cross-border backups exist?
3) Best times for a 60-min kickoff next week (we suggest Tue/Wed morning CET).

I've attached a draft playbook and a MAP template to speed edits. Marissa will own the MAP orchestration; Evelyn will manage the security evidence queue. Rishi will lead performance evaluation coordination.

Thanks — I’ll wait for owner names and any calendar preferences, then send a calendar invite and a shared doc.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solution Strategist
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0192

Thanks Kimberly — this looks helpful and aligns with our internal timeline. Quick answers below: 

Owners: 
- Data Governance: Rafael Torres (cc'd)
- Security Architecture: HelioFin Security (security@heliofin.com) — will nominate a primary later today
- Legal/Privacy: legal@heliofin.com (contact: Sarah Lin)
- Product Ops: Olivia Grant (me)

Regions / cross-border notes:
- Primary EU region: eu-west-1 (Frankfurt) for production, eu-central-1 (Amsterdam) for DR
- Cross-border backups: backups to non-EU regions are policy-restricted; there are currently two legacy backup jobs to us-central-1 that we need to audit (likely require migration/masking)

Kickoff availability: Tue Apr 13 10:00–11:00 CET or Wed Apr 14 09:00–10:00 CET. We prefer Tue 10:00 if that works for your team.

I'll also attach a short list of required SAML/SCIM endpoints and an existing diagram of our data flows as a separate email.

—Olivia

Team — forwarding Olivia's note. Actions: 
- Marissa: please draft the MAP in the shared doc and add discrete owners and deadlines. Start with our template (attached to original).
- Evelyn: once HelioFin sends their security contact, open a ticket for evidence collection and pre-fill with SOC2 sections we typically request (logs, retention, KMS keys, ingress/egress controls).
- Rishi: block time for perf benchmarking on eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 next week; we should pre-provision a small dedicated environment to run a baseline.

Also: brace for a backup-audit task — Olivia flagged legacy backups to us-central-1; expect a short questionnaire item about backup locations and encryption in transit/at rest.

I’ll schedule the kickoff for Tue Apr 13 at 10:00 CET and include a short agenda: introductions, MAP walkthrough, data flow Q&A, and evidence intake timeline.

—Kim

Onwards: please add any missing owners or push questions into the doc before EOD today.

- Add named owners to the MAP where appropriate
- Upload any current data flow diagrams to the linked Google doc before the meeting

- Evidence checklist (logs, retention policies, KMS details, encryption in transit/at rest)

If anything changes on your side, ping me directly and we’ll adjust. Look forward to the kickoff.
